info.description:
Better Metadata - Better Science

The impex server brings metadata into CEDAR from outside it. Today that means caDSR forms:
XML uploaded in chunks, translated into CEDAR templates, and saved into a folder of the caller's
choosing.

Translation runs in the background, so an upload returns before the templates exist. The status
endpoint is how a caller learns what became of each file.
info.title: CEDAR Impex Server API

post.description: Upload one or more caDSR XML forms, a chunk per request, and translate each into a CEDAR template. The upload is chunked, so a caller sends this repeatedly; the import starts by itself once the last chunk of an upload arrives. Translation then runs in the background, so a 200 means the chunk was stored and any import it completed was started, not that a template exists yet. Poll the import status to find out how it went.

parameters.description: Folder the templates are created in. Defaults to the caller's home folder.
parameters.name: folderId

200.description: The chunk was stored; any import it completed has been started

400.description: The request is not a multipart upload

500.description: The chunk could not be stored

post.summary: Upload caDSR forms and import them as templates

get.description: Report how an import is going, file by file: pending, in progress, complete, or in error, with the messages the translation produced. Without an upload identifier it reports every import the caller has run. Scoped to the caller either way, and an upload belonging to someone else is reported as not found rather than refused, so this cannot be used to discover another user's imports.

parameters.description: Upload identifier. Omit it to get every import the caller has run.
parameters.name: uploadId

200.description: The import status, or every status for the caller

404.description: The caller has no upload with this identifier

get.summary: Get the status of a caDSR import

api_key.description: Your CEDAR API key, using the format 'apiKey <yourApiKey>'
